description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

description.zh:
目标服务类型。
- Single：单服务
- Multiple：多服务
- VersionOriented：标签路由
- Mock：Mock
- Redirect：重定向
description.en:
The destination service type.

- Single: Single Service

- Multiple: Multiple Services

- VersionOriented: Label routing

- Mock: Mock

- Redirect: Redirect

description.zh: 已废弃，请使用UpdateGatewayRouteWafStatus更新路由WAF状态。
description.en: Deprecated. Use UpdateGatewayRouteWafStatus to update the WAF status of a route.
Indicates whether to enable the Fallback service.
The name of the group to which the service belongs.
The namespace in which the service resides.
The weight in the form of a percentage value.
The unique ID of the gateway.
The routing policy in a JSON string.
The configuration of the redirect action.

description.zh: 路由顺序。（数值越小优先级越高）
description.en: The sequence number of the route. (A small value indicates a high priority.)

description.zh:
路由类型：

Op：管控路由。
description.en:
The type of route. Valid values:

Op: Management route.

description.zh: 服务列表（路由指向为单服务、多服务、标签路由时填写）。
description.en: The service that you want to associate with the gateway. This parameter is required if the Route Point parameter is set to Single Service, Multiple Services, or Label routing.
The name of the service group.
The namespace to which the service belongs.

description.zh: 当前服务/服务版本分流百分比（只在使用多服务、标签路由时填写）。
description.en: The traffic weight of the service of a specific version, in percentage. This parameter is required if the Route Point parameter is set to Multiple Services or Label routing.

description.zh: 服务版本（只在使用标签路由时填写）。
description.en: The service version. This parameter is required only if the Route Point parameter is set to Label routing.
